orientation_reference.status: post-hoc diagnostic added after viewing first frozen neural runs; not part of original fixed neural comparison
orientation_reference.formula: sum horizontal adjacent products minus sum vertical adjacent products; score>=0 predicts horizontal
orientation_reference.scope: uses known orientation-task structure; no NLL because scores are not calibrated probability logits

protocol.optimizer: SGD without momentum or weight decay
protocol.selection: none; fixed schedule and architecture; validation descriptive only
protocol.normalization: none; synthetic intensities in declared generator units
